title: oes-telemetry-bench: offline replay bench for native synchronized OES32 telemetry frames
description:
oes-telemetry-bench is an offline Python replay and evaluation kit for native synchronized OES32 telemetry frames. Each observation must be one timestamped frame with exactly 32 named, finite channel values measured at that same timestamp. Thresholds are chosen only on a separate calibration replay and frozen before held-out scoring.

Evidence. The bundled demo is explicitly SYNTHETIC (deterministic generated noise, injected events, synthetic unlabeled transients). It demonstrates that the parser, calibration, replay, and metrics run; it does not establish field performance, detector superiority, a sensor mapping, or operational suitability.

Companion. The candidate detector matches the OES-Resilience oes32 definition. Related repository: oes-resilience.

Limits. Offline only: no live connection, no alarms, no equipment control. No QEC/consciousness/medical claims. Do not mint a GitHub release until the Zenodo webhook is enabled.
notes: Evidence status: SYNTHETIC demo only. Offline replay; no field-performance claims. Commercial licensing: see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md. Do not mint a GitHub release until the Zenodo webhook is enabled.
